check: brute-force throttling on /login/ (form) and /api/v1/security/login (REST): 20 bad attempts each
observed: no throttling observed (12-20 bad attempts each: all 302 / all 401). AUTH_RATE_LIMITED='5 per 40 second' is loaded, but the only Redis limiter key present right after the attempts is the GLOBAL one (LIMITER/<ip>/global/50/1/second); no login-specific key => the login limit is not applied to either login path in this build/config (root cause undiagnosed). Separately verified: the global 50 req/s per-IP limit IS active (HTTP 429 under burst)
note: mitigate at reverse proxy/WAF; keep Superset off the public internet; IdP handles human login
